messages:
mia_cs: @sophie_eng FYI — customer (Acme Inc) says a promo credit landed in an archived org after their SSO consolidation. They can see the balance in the admin console but not from their active workspace. Can we triage? :wave:

sophie_eng: Can you paste the org IDs and the promo code? Any console snapshot or the grant event id would help. Also: did they do any manual org merges/archival recently? :mag:

mia_cs: Details below from the customer and our admin logs:
```
Archived org id: org_arch_789
Active org id: org_act_123
Promo code: PROMO-RED-2025
Grant event id: evt_2025_555
Customer says they consolidated SSO on 2025-03-09 and archived the previous org a few hours before the promo was issued.
```

promo-bot: Promo grant applied -> org: org_arch_789, event: evt_2025_555, amount: 5000 credits, time: 2025-03-09T14:12:07Z

alex_billing: I can reassign the credits to the active org but per policy we need explicit customer consent logged in the ticket. If Acme confirms in-thread I'll process the transfer and add an audit note. Also will attach a billing adjustment entry. :lock:

acme_admin: Confirming here — please move the 5000 promo credits from org_arch_789 to org_act_123. We authorize Redwood to reassign the grant. Thanks.

raj_ops: Thanks @acme_admin. Quick hypothesis: during the SSO consolidation we left a stale external_id mapping pointing to the archived org. Promo grant routing picks the first match and attached to org_arch_789. Need to check the SSO->org mapping table and grant router logic.

raj_ops: Short repro for eng (high level):
1) Create org A with SSO (external_id X)
2) Archive org A (org_arch_789) but keep SSO mapping intact
3) Provision new org B that reuses external_id X (org_act_123)
4) Trigger promo grant -> router picks the older archived mapping if ordering not enforced

raj_ops: Quick ops workaround (one-off):
```bash
# transfer credits securely with audit
redwoodctl org credit transfer --from org_arch_789 --to org_act_123 --amount 5000 --reason "SSO consolidation misapplied PROMO-RED-2025" --ticket ticket-12345

# get the grant event for audit
redwoodctl audit events --filter evt_2025_555 --format json
```

sophie_eng: Please attach the audit output and the grant event payload once you run that. Engineering will want the full event to patch the router ordering (and add a guard for archived orgs).

alex_billing: I'll queue the transfer once I see the customer's explicit confirm here (we have it from @acme_admin). Mia, can you paste the ticket id so I can link the billing adjustment?

mia_cs: Ticket is #CS-4821, linking now. I'll run the audit command and post the payload in the ticket.

sophie_eng: For the fix, engineering will: 1) prefer non-archived orgs when resolving external_id collisions, 2) add an integration test for promo routing, 3) add an alert if a grant lands on an archived org.

acme_admin: Appreciate the quick help, thank you all. Happy to be on the record for the consent.

alex_billing: Done — I'm initiating the transfer and adding a billing note referencing ticket CS-4821. Will post the transfer audit id when complete. :white_check_mark:

mia_cs: Will update the customer thread after transfer finishes. Thanks team! :trophy:
